title: Dua e Sabah
introduction:
DUA AL SABAH

The Supplication of the Morning, as reported from Imam Ali (a.s.).

Then you should prostrate yourself and say:

‘Allamah al-Majlisi has mentioned this supplication in the two sections of supplications and ritual prayer in his famous book of Bihar al-Anwar. He has also recorded it at the end of the section of ritual prayer with commentary and explanation. He adds,

“Although this is one of the famous supplications, I have not found it in the authoritative books except the book of al-Misbah by Sayyid Ibn Baqi - may Allah be pleased with him.”

He then says,

“It is well-known that this supplication should be said after the obligatory Fajr Prayers. Yet, Sayyid Ibn Baqi has specified the time after the supererogatory (mustahab / nafilah) (mustahab / nafilah) prayer of the morning as the best time of saying this supplication. However, either of these times may be chosen.”

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِ
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ يَا مَنْ دَلَعَ لِسَانَ الصَّبَاحِ بِنُطْقِ تَبَلُّجِهِ
verses.translation: O Allah, O He Who extended the morning's tongue in the speech of its dawning,

verses.arabic: وَ سَرَّحَ قِطَعَ اللَّيْلِ الْمُظْلِمِ بِغَيَاهِبِ تَلَجْلُجِهِ
verses.translation: dispatched the fragments of the dark night into the gloom of its stammering,

verses.arabic: وَ اَتْقَنَ صُنْعَ الْفَلَكِ الدَّوَّارِ فِيْ مَقَادِيْرِ تَبَرُّجِهِ
verses.translation: made firm the structure of the turning spheres in the measure of its display,

verses.arabic: وَ شَعْشَعَ ضِيَاۤءَ الشَّمْسِ بِنُوْرِ تَاَجُّجِهِ
verses.translation: and beamed forth the brightness of the sun through the light of its blazing!

verses.arabic: يَا مَنْ دَلَّ عَلٰى ذَاتِهِ بِذَاتِهِ
verses.translation: O He Who demonstrates His Essence by His Essence,

verses.arabic: وَ تَنَزَّهَ عَنْ مُجَانَسَةِ مَخْلُوْقَاتِهِ
verses.translation: transcends from congeniality with His creatures,

verses.arabic: وَ جَلَّ عَنْ مُلَاۤءَمَةِ كَيْفِيَّاتِهِ
verses.translation: and is exalted beyond conformity with His qualities!

verses.arabic: يَا مَنْ قَرُبَ مِنْ خَطَرَاتِ الظُّنُوْنِ
verses.translation: O He Who is near to the passing thoughts of opinions,

verses.arabic: وَ بَعُدَ عَنْ لَحَظَاتِ الْعُيُوْنِ
verses.translation: far from the regards of eyes,

verses.arabic: وَ عَلِمَ بِمَا كَانَ قَبْلَ اَنْ يَكُوْنَ
verses.translation: and knows what will be before it comes to be!

verses.arabic: يَا مَنْ اَرْقَدَنِيْ فِيْ مِهَادِ اَمْنِهِ وَ اَمَانِهِ
verses.translation: O He Who has put me at ease in the cradle of His security and sanctuary,

verses.arabic: وَ اَيْقَظَنِيْ اِلٰى مَا مَنَحَنِيْ بِهِ مِنْ مِنَنِهِ وَ اِحْسَانِهِ
verses.translation: awakened me to the favors and kindness that He has bestowed upon me,

verses.arabic: وَ كَفَّ اَكُفَّ السُّوۤءِ عَنِّيْ بِيَدِهِ وَ سُلْطَانِهِ
verses.translation: and held back from me the claws of evil with His hand and His authority!

verses.arabic: صَلِّ اللّٰهُمَّ عَلَى الدَّلِيْلِ اِلَيْكَ فِي اللَّيْلِ الْاَلْيَلِ،
verses.translation: Bless, O Allah, the guide to You in the darkest night,

verses.arabic: وَ الْمَاسِكِ مِنْ اَسْبَابِكَ بِحَبْلِ الشَّرَفِ الْاَطْوَلِ
verses.translation: who, of Your ropes, clings to the cord of the longest nobility,

verses.arabic: وَ النَّاصِعِ الْحَسَبِ فِي ذِرْوَةِ الْكَاهِلِ الْاَعْبَلِ
verses.translation: whose pure lineage evident at the summit of stout shoulders,

verses.arabic: وَ الثَّابِتِ الْقَدَمِ عَلٰى زَحَالِيْفِهَا فِي الزَّمَنِ الْاَوَّلِ
verses.translation: and whose feet were entrenched in spite of slippery places in ancient time.

verses.arabic: وَ عَلٰى اٰلِهِ الْاَخْيَارِ الْمُصْطَفَيْنَ الْاَبْرَارِ
verses.translation: And [bless] his household, the good, chosen, and pious.

verses.arabic: وَ افْتَحِ اللّٰهُمَّ لَنَا مَصَارِيْعَ الصَّبَاحِ
verses.translation: Open for us, O Allah, the leaves of the morning's door

verses.arabic: بِمَفَاتِيْحِ الرَّحْمَةِ وَ الْفَلَاحِ
verses.translation: with the keys of mercy and prosperity!

verses.arabic: وَ اَلْبِسْنِيْ اَللّٰهُمَّ مِنْ اَفْضَلِ خِلَعِ الْهِدَايَةِ وَ الصَّلَاحِ
verses.translation: Clothe me, O Allah, with the most excellent robes of guidance and righteousness!

verses.arabic: وَ اغْرِسِ اللّٰهُمَّ بِعَظَمَتِكَ فِي شِرْبِ جَنَانِيْ يَنَابِيْعَ الْخُشُوْعِ
verses.translation: Plant, O Allah, through Your tremendousness, the springs of humility in the watering place of my heart!

verses.arabic: وَ اَجْرِ اللّٰهُمَّ لِهَيْبَتِكَ مِنْ اٰمَاقِيْ زَفَرَاتِ الدُّمُوْعِ
verses.translation: Cause to flow, O Allah, through fear of You, tears of moaning from the corners of my eyes!

verses.arabic: وَ اَدِّبِ اللّٰهُمَّ نَزَقَ الْخُرْقِ مِنِّيْ بِاَزِمَّةِ الْقُنُوْعِ۔
verses.translation: Chastise, O Allah, the recklessness of my clumsiness with the reins of contentment!

verses.arabic: اِلٰهِيْ اِنْ لَمْ تَبْتَدِئْنِيْ الرَّحْمَةُ مِنْكَ بِحُسْنِ التَّوْفِيْقِ
verses.translation: My God, if mercy from You does not begin with fair success for me,

verses.arabic: فَمَنِ السَّالِكُ بِيْ اِلَيْكَ فِيْ وَاضِحِ الطَّرِيْقِ
verses.translation: then who can take me to You upon the evident path?

verses.arabic: وَ اِنْ اَسْلَمَتْنِيْ اَنَاتُكَ لِقَاۤئِدِ الْاَمَلِ وَ الْمُنٰى
verses.translation: If Your deliberateness should turn me over to the guide of hope and wishes,

verses.arabic: فَمَنِ الْمُقِيْلُ عَثَرَاتِيْ مِنْ كَبَوَاتِ الْهَوٰى
verses.translation: then who will annul my slips from the stumbles of caprice?

verses.arabic: وَ اِنْ خَذَلَنِيْ نَصْرُكَ عِنْدَ مُحَارَبَةِ النَّفْسِ وَ الشَّيْطَانِ
verses.translation: If Your help should forsake me in the battle against the soul and Satan,

verses.arabic: فَقَدْ وَكَلَنِيْ خِذْلَانُكَ اِلٰى حَيْثُ النَّصَبُ وَ الْحِرْمَانُ۔
verses.translation: then Your forsaking will have submitted me to where there is hardship and deprivation.

verses.arabic: اِلٰهِيْ اَتَرَانِيْ مَا اَتَيْتُكَ اِلَّا مِنْ حَيْثُ الْاٰمَالُ
verses.translation: My God, do You see that I have only come to You from the direction of hopes,

verses.arabic: اَمْ عَلِقْتُ بِاَطْرَافِ حِبَالِكَ اِلَّا حِيْنَ بَاعَدَتْنِيْ ذُنُوْبِيْ عَنْ دَارِ [صِرْبَةِ] الْوِصَالِ
verses.translation: or clung to the ends of Your cords when my sins have driven me from the house of union?

verses.arabic: فَبِئْسَ الْمَطِيَّةُ الَّتِي امْتَطَتْ نَفْسِيْ مِنْ هَوَاهَا
verses.translation: So what an evil mount upon which my soul has mounted-its caprice!

verses.arabic: فَوَاهَا لَهَا لِمَا سَوَّلَتْ لَهَا ظُنُوْنُهَا وَ مُنَاهَا
verses.translation: Woe upon it for being seduced by its own opinions and wishes!

verses.arabic: وَ تَبَّا لَهَا لِجُرْاَتِهَا عَلٰى سَيِّدِهَا وَ مَوْلَاهَا
verses.translation: Destruction be upon it for its audacity toward its Master and Protector!

verses.arabic: اِلٰهِيْ قَرَعْتُ بَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ بِيَدِ رَجَاۤئِي
verses.translation: My God, I have knocked upon the door of Your mercy with the hand of my hope,

verses.arabic: وَ هَرَبْتُ اِلَيْكَ لَاجِئَا مِنْ فَرْطِ اَهْوَاۤئِي
verses.translation: fled to You seeking refuge from my excessive caprice,

verses.arabic: وَ عَلَّقْتُ بِاَطْرَافِ حِبَالِكَ اَنَامِلَ وَلَاۤئِي
verses.translation: and fixed the fingers of my love to the ends of Your cords.

verses.arabic: فَاصْفَحِ اللّٰهُمَّ عَمَّا كُنْتُ [كَانَ‏] اَجْرَمْتُهُ مِنْ زَلَلِيْ وَ خَطَاۤئِيْ
verses.translation: So pardon, O Allah, the slips and errors I have committed,

verses.arabic: وَ اَقِلْنِيْ مِنْ صَرْعَةِ رِدَاۤئِيْ
verses.translation: and release me from the foot-tangling of my robe,

verses.arabic: فَاِنَّكَ سَيِّدِيْ وَ مَوْلَايَ وَ مُعْتَمَدِيْ وَ رَجَاۤئِي،
verses.translation: for You are my Master, my Protector, my Support and my Hope,

verses.arabic: وَ اَنْتَ غَايَةُ مَطْلُوْبِيْ وَ مُنَايَ فِيْ مُنْقَلَبِيْ وَ مَثْوَايَ
verses.translation: and You are the object of my search and my desire in my ultimate end and stable abode.

verses.arabic: اِلٰهِيْ كَيْفَ تَطْرُدُ مِسْكِيْنًا الْتَجَاَ اِلَيْكَ مِنَ الذُّنُوْبِ هَارِبًا
verses.translation: My God, how could You drive away a poor beggar who seeks refuge in You from sins, fleeing?

verses.arabic: اَمْ كَيْفَ تُخَيِّبُ مُسْتَرْشِدًا قَصَدَ اِلٰى جَنَابِكَ سَاعِيًا [صَاقِبًا]
verses.translation: How could You disappoint one seeking guidance who repairs to Your threshold, running?

verses.arabic: اَمْ كَيْفَ تَرُدُّ ظَمْاٰنَ وَرَدَ اِلٰى حِيَاضِكَ شَارِبًا
verses.translation: How could You reject a thirsty man who comes to Your pools to drink?

verses.arabic: كَلَا وَ حِيَاضُكَ مُتْرَعَةٌ فِيْ ضَنْكِ الْمُحُوْلِ
verses.translation: Never! For Your pools are full in the hardship of drought,

verses.arabic: وَ بَابُكَ مَفْتُوْحٌ لِلطَّلَبِ وَ الْوُغُوْلِ
verses.translation: Your door is open for seeking and penetration,

verses.arabic: وَ اَنْتَ غَايَةُ الْمَسْئُوْلِ [السُّؤْلِ‏] وَ نِهَايَةُ الْمَأْمُوْلِ
verses.translation: and You are the goal of requests and the object of hopes.

verses.arabic: اِلٰهِيْ هٰذِهِ اَزِمَّةُ نَفْسِيْ عَقَلْتُهَا بِعِقَالِ مَشِيَّتِكَ
verses.translation: My God, these are the reins of my soul I have bounded with the ties of Your will.

verses.arabic: وَ هٰذِهِ اَعْبَاۤءُ ذُنُوْبِي دَرَأْتُهَا بِعَفْوِكَ وَ رَحْمَتِكَ،
verses.translation: These are the burdens of my sins I have averted with Your pardon and mercy.

verses.arabic: وَ هٰذِهِ اَهْوَاۤئِيَ الْمُضِلَّةُ وَكَلْتُهَا اِلٰى جَنَابِ لُطْفِكَ وَ رَأْفَتِكَ
verses.translation: These are my misleading caprices I have referred to the threshold of Your gentleness and kindliness.

verses.arabic: فَاجْعَلِ اللّٰهُمَّ صَبَاحِيْ هٰذَا نَازِلًا عَلَيَّ بِضِيَاۤءِ الْهُدٰى
verses.translation: So, make this morning of mine, O Allah, descend upon me with the radiance of guidance

verses.arabic: وَ بِالسَّلَامَةِ [السَّلَامَةِ] فِي الدِّيْنِ وَ الدُّنْيَا
verses.translation: and safety in religion and this world!

verses.arabic: وَ مَسَاۤئِيْ جُنَّةً مِنْ كَيْدِ الْعِدٰى [الْاَعْدَاۤءِ]
verses.translation: And [make] my evening a shield against the deception of enemies

verses.arabic: وَ وِقَايَةً مِنْ مُرْدِيَاتِ الْهَوٰى
verses.translation: and a protection against the destructive blows of caprice!

verses.arabic: اِنَّكَ قَادِرٌ عَلٰى مَا تَشَاۤءُ
verses.translation: Verily, You have power to do what You will!

verses.arabic: تُؤْتِي الْمُلْكَ مَنْ تَشَاۤءُ
verses.translation: You give the kingdom to whom You will,

verses.arabic: وَ تَنْزِعُ الْمُلْكَ مِمَّنْ تَشَاۤءُ
verses.translation: seize the kingdom from whom You will,

verses.arabic: وَ تُعِزُّ مَنْ تَشَاۤءُ
verses.translation: exalt whom You will,

verses.arabic: وَ تُذِلُّ مَنْ تَشَاۤءُ
verses.translation: and abase whom You will.

verses.arabic: بِيَدِكَ الْخَيْرُ
verses.translation: In Your hand is the good

verses.arabic: اِنَّكَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَيْ‏ءٍ قَدِيْرٌ
verses.translation: and You are powerful over all things.

verses.arabic: تُوْلِجُ اللَّيْلَ فِي النَّهَارِ
verses.translation: You make the night to enter into the day,

verses.arabic: وَ تُوْلِجُ النَّهَارَ فِي اللَّيْلِ
verses.translation: make the day to enter into the night,

verses.arabic: وَ تُخْرِجُ الْحَيَّ مِنَ الْمَيِّتِ
verses.translation: bring forth the living from the dead,

verses.arabic: وَ تُخْرِجُ الْمَيِّتَ مِنَ الْحَيِّ
verses.translation: bring forth the dead from the living,

verses.arabic: وَ تَرْزُقُ مَنْ تَشَاۤءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
verses.translation: and provide whomsoever You will without measure!

verses.arabic: لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ
verses.translation: There is no god but You!

verses.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللّٰهُمَّ وَ بِحَمْدِكَ
verses.translation: Glory be to You, O Allah, and Yours is the praise!

verses.arabic: مَنْ ذَا يَعْرِفُ قَدْرَكَ فَلَا يَخَافُكَ،
verses.translation: Who knows Your measure and yet does not fear You?

verses.arabic: وَ مَنْ ذَا يَعْلَمُ مَا اَنْتَ فَلَا يَهَابُكَ
verses.translation: Who knows what You are and yet does not stand in awe of You?

verses.arabic: اَلَّفْتَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ الْفِرَقَ
verses.translation: Through Your power, You have joined disparate things,

verses.arabic: وَ فَلَقْتَ بِلُطْفِكَ الْفَلَقَ
verses.translation: through Your gentleness, You have cleaved apart the daybreak,

verses.arabic: وَ اَنَرْتَ بِكَرَمِكَ دَيَاجِيَ الْغَسَقِ
verses.translation: through Your generosity, You have illumined the dark shrouds of night,

verses.arabic: وَ اَنْهَرْتَ الْمِيَاهَ مِنَ الصُّمِّ الصَّيَاخِيْدِ عَذْبًا وَ اُجَاجًا
verses.translation: made waters, sweet and salt, flow forth from hard shining stones,

verses.arabic: وَ اَنْزَلْتَ مِنَ الْمُعْصِرَاتِ مَاۤءً ثَجَّاجًا
verses.translation: sent dawn out of rain- clouds water cascading,

verses.arabic: وَ جَعَلْتَ الشَّمْسَ وَ الْقَمَرَ لِلْبَرِيَّةِ سِرَاجًا وَهَّاجًا
verses.translation: and appointed the sun and the moon a blazing lamp for the creatures

verses.arabic: مِنْ غَيْرِ اَنْ تُمَارِسَ فِيْمَا ابْتَدَأْتَ بِهِ لُغُوْبًا وَ لَا عِلَاجًا
verses.translation: without experiencing in that which You originated either weariness or effort.

verses.arabic: فَيَا مَنْ تَوَحَّدَ بِالْعِزِّ وَ الْبَقَاۤءِ
verses.translation: So, O He Who is alone in might and subsistence

verses.arabic: وَ قَهَرَ عِبَادَهُ بِالْمَوْتِ وَ الْفَنَاۤءِ
verses.translation: and dominates His slaves with death and annihilation,

verses.arabic: صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِهِ الْاَتْقِيَاۤءِ
verses.translation: (please) bless Muhammad and his household, the god-fearing,

verses.arabic: وَ اسْمَعْ نِدَاۤئِيْ، وَ اسْتَجِبْ دُعَاۤئِيْ
verses.translation: answer my supplication, hear my call,

verses.arabic: وَ حَقِّقْ بِفَضْلِكَ اَمَلِيْ وَ رَجَاۤئِيْ
verses.translation: and actualize through Your favor my hope and desire.

verses.arabic: يَا خَيْرَ مَنْ دُعِيَ لِكَشْفِ الضُّرِّ
verses.translation: O Best of those who are called to remove affliction

verses.arabic: وَ الْمَأْمُوْلِ لِكُلِّ [فِيْ كُلِ‏] عُسْرٍ وَ يُسْرٍ
verses.translation: and object of hope in difficulty and ease!

verses.arabic: بِكَ اَنْزَلْتُ حَاجَتِيْ فَلَا تَرُدَّنِيْ مِنْ سَنِيِّ [بَابِ‏] مَوَاهِبِكَ خَاۤئِبًا
verses.translation: I have stated my need to You; so, do not reject me despairing of Your exalted gifts.

verses.arabic: يَا كَرِيْمُ يَا كَرِيْمُ يَا كَرِيْمُ
verses.translation: O All-generous! O All- generous! O All- generous!

verses.arabic: بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَاۤ اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ
verses.translation: By Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful!

verses.arabic: وَ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلٰى خَيْرِ خَلْقِهِ
verses.translation: May Allah bless the best of His creatures,

verses.arabic: مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِهِ اَجْمَعِيْنَ۔
verses.translation: Muhammad, and his entire Household!

verses.arabic: اِلٰهِيْ قَلْبِيْ مَحْجُوْبٌ
verses.translation: My God, my heart is veiled,

verses.arabic: وَ نَفْسِيْ مَعْيُوْبٌ
verses.translation: my soul is deficient,

verses.arabic: وَ عَقْلِيْ مَغْلُوْبٌ
verses.translation: my intelligence is defeated,

verses.arabic: وَ هَوَاۤئِيْ غَالِبٌ
verses.translation: my caprice is prevalent,

verses.arabic: وَ طَاعَتِيْ قَلِيْلٌ
verses.translation: my obedience is little,

verses.arabic: وَ مَعْصِيَتِيْ كَثِيْرٌ
verses.translation: my disobedience is much,

verses.arabic: وَ لِسَانِيْ مُقِرٌّ بِالذُّنُوْبِ
verses.translation: and my tongue confesses of sinning;

verses.arabic: فَكَيْفَ حِيْلَتِيْ
verses.translation: so, what am I to do?

verses.arabic: يَا سَتَّارَ الْعُيُوْبِ
verses.translation: O He Who covers defects!

verses.arabic: وَ يَا عَلَّامَ الْغُيُوْبِ
verses.translation: O He Who knows the unseen!

verses.arabic: وَ يَا كَاشِفَ الْكُرُوْبِ
verses.translation: O He Who removes troubles!

verses.arabic: اغْفِرْ ذُنُوْبِيْ كُلَّهَا
verses.translation: Forgive my sins, all of them,

verses.arabic: بِحُرْمَةِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
verses.translation: in the name of the sacredness of Muhammad and the household of Muhammad!

verses.arabic: يَا غَفَّارُ يَا غَفَّارُ يَا غَفَّارُ
verses.translation: O All-forgiver! O All- forgiver! O All- forgiver!

verses.arabic: بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَاۤ اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ۔
verses.translation: By Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful!
